text.p: Estonia's construction company Merko will issue 722,705 shares to raise its share capital to 29 million kroons between June 2-16, Balti Cresco said on Monday.
The price of the 10-kroon face value share will be 100 kroons, Indrek Rahumaa, head of corporate finance, told Reuters.
The company hopes its shares WILL be listed on the main list of the Tallinn bourse a week after the issue, Rahumaa added.
The issue, which makes up 25 percent of its present share capital, will raise Merko's equity to over 100 million kroons.
"The Estonian construction industry is becoming more capital intensive and most of the projects are financed with equity, which gives a certain guarantee in the market," Rahumaa said.
Merko had a turnover of 209 million kroons and a net profit of 9.9 million kroons in 1996. Turnover in the first quarter of 1997 was 72 million kroons and its net profit was 5.1 million kroons.
